stories.title: OpenAI Drops GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol – The Next Leap in Code & Creativity
stories.hook: OpenAI just launched two game‑changing models that can write code and generate art faster than ever.
stories.angle: On November 17, 2026 OpenAI released GPT‑6.2 Astra and its sibling GPT‑6.2 Sol, each boasting higher inference speeds and fine‑tuned safety layers. The dual launch underscores OpenAI’s strategy to dominate both developer tooling and creative AI markets while setting new industry benchmarks.
stories.money_angle: Developers can slash subscription costs by switching to the more efficient GPT‑6.2 Sol for API usage, freeing budget for scale.
stories.visual_world: High‑resolution renderings of the OpenAI logo, the GPT‑6.2 landing page, code editors filling with AI‑generated snippets, and a living‑room scene where a user watches AI create a painting in seconds.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Lets AIs Work in Teams – Google’s New Multi‑AI Collaboration Tool
stories.hook: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon finally lets multiple AI agents finish a job together, like a 100‑person team in a single prompt.
stories.angle: Released on November 12, 2026, Gemini 4 Carbon adds the ability for separate Gemini agents to delegate tasks, share context, and sync outputs in real time. This breakthrough positions Google as the frontline challenger to OpenAI’s single‑model supremacy.
stories.money_angle: Content creators can use Gemini 4 Carbon to generate multi‑section videos in minutes, boosting output and revenue potential.
stories.visual_world: Animated split‑screen of Gemini agents exchanging text, a dashboard showing task allocation, and a creative studio where an artist sees AI‑generated layers auto‑added to a design.

stories.title: Anthropic Breaks IPO Records – The $10 B Public Debut That Shook Wall Street
stories.hook: Anthropic went public yesterday and crushed all IPO benchmarks, sending its shares soaring for a buyer frenzy.
stories.angle: On November 20, 2026, Anthropic’s public offering raised over $10 billion, the largest AI‑company IPO ever. The $720 million final valuation marks a milestone for the industry and signals investor confidence in controllable, high‑performance AI.
stories.money_angle: Investors can grab Anthropic stock early in the aftermarket to capture overnight upside from the record debut.
stories.visual_world: Stock ticker with soaring numbers, a trading floor with analysts celebrating, slide shows of the Anthropic logo and product demos, a pile of freshly printed IPO prospectus sheets.

stories.title: CoreWeave Rockets 22 % as Nvidia Returns Huang – The AI Cloud’s Massive Upswing
stories.hook: After Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, CoreWeave surged 22 %, proving AI‑cloud demand is still roaring.
stories.angle: On November 23, 2026 stock markets reacted to Nvidia’s CEO reversal, lifting AI cloud providers. CoreWeave’s shares jumped 22 %, driven by renewed investor confidence and a surge in AI‑related workload demand across Fortune‑500 firms.
stories.money_angle: Shares of CoreWeave now offer a high‑return entry point for investors looking for exposure to the AI‑infrastructure boom.

stories.title: OpenAI Drops GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol – The Next Leap in Code & Creativity
stories.summary: On November 17 2026 OpenAI released GPT‑6.2 Astra and GPT‑6.2 Sol, offering higher inference speed and tighter safety. Astra’s API price fell 20 % to $8 per million tokens, while Sol stayed at $2, making Sol the cheaper choice for high‑volume code generation. Both models outperform prior releases on the Epoch Capabilities Index and are available for Codex and ChatGPT Work.

Astra & Sol available in Codex and ChatGPT Work
stories.money_angle: Use the free GPT‑6.2 Sol at $2 per 1M tokens to run your automated‑coding pipeline, cutting costs by ~50 % compared to GPT‑6.1.

stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Lets AIs Work in Teams – Google’s New Multi‑AI Collaboration Tool
stories.summary: Google debuted Gemini 4 Carbon on November 12 2026, enabling distinct Gemini agents to delegate tasks, share context, and sync outputs in real time. The model was rolled out to developers and enterprises via a new API and is the first Google LLM to support multi‑agent collaboration. Gemini 4 Carbon is positioned to compete with OpenAI’s single‑model dominance and is available for general use on its GA release day.
key_facts: Agents can delegate, share context, sync outputs
API now available to developers and enterprises
Focus on complex programming and cyber‑security tasks
Runs on Google AI Ultra subscription
stories.money_angle: Launch a 5‑minute content‑creation workflow that splits a video into intro, mid‑section, and outro agents, then stitches them together—try the free community demo on Google Cloud this week.

stories.title: Anthropic Breaks IPO Records – The $10 B Public Debut That Shook Wall Street
stories.summary: On November 20 2026 Anthropic raised $81 billion in its IPO, the largest ever for an AI company, with shares priced at $83 and a final valuation surpassing $10 B. The offering closed 34 % higher on its first trading day and gave founders $280 M each when sold. Shares fell below the IPO price in pre‑market but opened well above and are now trading around $97.5.
stories.money_angle: Buy Anthropic stock in the aftermarket when it trades above $100 to capture overnight upside, or use the free 14‑day market data experiment on Bloomberg Terminal to time entries.
